title: Real-Time Inventory Management & Stock Mutation System
subtitle: ACID-guaranteed warehouse ERP simulation with standardized product catalog, atomic stock IN/OUT mutations, traceability audit ledger, interactive movement analytics, and 9Router AI Copilot.

demoSection.title: Test 3 System Roles Directly
demoSection.subtitle: 3 official demo accounts ready to use without sign-up. The login page provides 1-click chips for automated credential filling.

admin.title: Administrator
admin.desc: Full access to catalog, stock mutations, AI product commits, user management, and system settings.

staff.title: Warehouse Staff
staff.desc: Operational access to single & batch IN/OUT stock recording; restricted from master catalog & reports.

auditor.title: Auditor (Owner)
auditor.desc: Read-only inspection access for catalog, KPI dashboard, analytics reports, ledger, and AI Q&A.

modulesSection.title: 6 Core Modules According to Technical Spec
modulesSection.subtitle: All modules specified in the Take Home Test FSE document (Modules A through F) have been fully implemented and verified.

modulA.title: Simulated Login & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
modulA.desc: Secure cookie session auth via @supabase/ssr, 3 consolidated user roles, direct URL protection in Edge Middleware & Layouts, and pre-seeded demo accounts.

modulB.title: Product Catalog & Unique SKU Standardization
modulB.desc: Synchronization of 30 initial products from dummyjson.com/products, deterministic unique SKUs, RESTRICT-linked categories, and catalog stock immutability.

modulC.title: Physical Stock Mutation Logging & ACID Batch Transactions
modulC.desc: Stock IN (add) and OUT (deduct) recording, strict positive integer validation, overdraft prevention, and all-or-nothing multi-item cart transactions.

modulD.title: Historical Ledger & Stock Traceability
modulD.desc: Comprehensive ledger tracking local timestamp, product SKU, mutation type, quantity, stock before → after transition, executor user, and reference notes.

modulE.title: Executive Inventory Summary & Flow Analytics
modulE.desc: Executive KPI dashboard showing total SKUs, physical units, precise IDR valuation, critical low stock watchlist (< 5 units), and interactive SVG flow chart.

modulF.title: 9Router AI Copilot Integration (Server-Only)
modulF.desc: Intelligent assistant powered by private 9Router gateway (inventra model): draft product generator (stock locked to 0), spec refiner, and factual warehouse Q&A.

rulesSection.title: Compliance with Key Assessment Rules
rulesSection.subtitle: Every business rule is strictly enforced by Zod Schemas, PostgreSQL Database Constraints, and Vitest Unit Tests.

rules.title: Stock Overdraft Prevention
rules.desc: Outbound stock mutations (Stock OUT) must never exceed available inventory. Transactions are rejected and aborted (INSUFFICIENT_STOCK).

rules.title: Positive Integer Quantities Required
rules.desc: Inputs of 0, negative, decimal, or non-numeric values are rejected immediately without altering stock or movement history.

rules.title: Stock Mathematical Consistency
rules.desc: Current stock is guaranteed consistent: Current Stock = Opening Stock + Total IN - Total OUT.

rules.title: Critical Stock Flag (Low Stock Alert)
rules.desc: Items with fewer than 5 units in stock (< 5) automatically display a prominent visual alert badge across catalog and dashboard.

rules.title: Currency Conversion to Rupiah
rules.desc: USD prices from DummyJSON are converted to Indonesian Rupiah (Rp 16,000 / USD) and formatted with proper thousand separators.

rules.title: Traceability Movement Ledger
rules.desc: Every mutation permanently logs exact stock transitions (before → after), timestamps, and reference notes for audit tracing.
